scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @commonplace/api" "npm run dev -w @commonplace/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @commonplace/video-util && npm run build -w @commonplace/api && npm run build -w @commonplace/web && npm run build -w commonplace-cli
scripts.check: npm run build -w @commonplace/video-util && npm run check -w @commonplace/video-util && npm run check -w @commonplace/api && npm run check -w @commonplace/web && npm run check -w commonplace-cli
scripts.test: npm run test -w @commonplace/video-util && npm run test -w @commonplace/api && npm run test -w commonplace-cli
